# G-Tech I.T Solution

> G-Tech I.T Solution (जी-टेक आई.टी. सोलुसन) is an IT services and enterprise technology company headquartered at College Road, Dharan-9, 56700, Sunsari, Nepal, operating since 2019. It positions itself as the #1 IT company in Nepal. It delivers software and web development, custom ERP and CRM systems, mobile app development, AI and automation, cybersecurity, cloud and server infrastructure, enterprise networking and structured cabling, CCTV surveillance, annual maintenance contracts, biometric attendance systems, hardware repair, strategic IT consulting, and a certified training and internship programme. It serves all 77 districts of Nepal. Service descriptions, client lists and certifications are the company's own public statements. It does not publish prices; a free consultation is available.

Also written as: G-Tech IT Solution, G-Tech I.T. Solution, G-Tech Information Technology Solution, GTech IT Solution. Not to be confused with unrelated companies named G-Tech in Houston, Austin, Israel, Mumbai or elsewhere.

## Services

- [Technical support and helpdesk](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): 24/7 technical support in Dharan and across Nepal — desktop repair, laptop servicing, server maintenance, network troubleshooting, on-demand IT helpdesk.
- [CCTV surveillance and installation](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): CCTV camera installation in Dharan, Sunsari and Nepal — AI-powered security cameras, IP surveillance, DVR/NVR setup, night vision, mobile live streaming.
- [Networking and structured cabling](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): gigabit LAN, SD-WAN, VPNs, firewalls, Wi-Fi access points, fibre optic cabling, server rack installations.
- [Annual maintenance contracts](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): AMC IT services covering hardware maintenance, server health checks, printer repair and network uptime for schools, hospitals and offices.
- [Software and web development](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): enterprise applications, custom ERP, CRM, school management systems, high-performance websites.
- [Mobile app development](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): native iOS and Android apps with modern UX and cloud backend integrations.
- [Artificial intelligence and automation](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): custom ML models, NLP solutions, predictive analytics, intelligent AI automation, enterprise R&D.
- [Cybersecurity and data protection](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): threat detection, firewall security audits, penetration testing, zero-trust architecture, 24/7 security monitoring.
- [IT infrastructure and server setup](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): infrastructure design, server installation, virtualisation, Linux and Windows administration, secure cloud integration.
- [Hardware maintenance and repair](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): preventive and on-demand computer repair, PC hardware upgrading, printer maintenance, IT equipment lifecycle management.
- [Strategic IT consulting](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): helping companies, educational institutions and healthcare providers optimize digital workflows and IT investments.
- [Biometric and attendance systems](https://g-main1.github.io/gtechit-blog/#what-services-does-g-tech-i-t-solution-provide): facial recognition and fingerprint attendance, electronic access control, time-tracking hardware.

## Industries

- Schools and colleges — digital infrastructure, smart classrooms, biometric attendance, AMC support.
- Universities and research — campus network setup, computer lab maintenance, secure servers, cloud infrastructure.
- Hospitals and healthcare — health IT systems, 24/7 server uptime, hospital CCTV, network reliability.
- Government and municipalities — secure compliant infrastructure, public sector software, smart municipality IT.
- NGOs and INGOs — cost-effective IT support, secure cloud storage, hardware maintenance, nationwide remote assistance.
- Small and medium businesses — computer repair, CCTV setup, POS systems, web development, local IT support.
- Enterprises and financial firms — digital transformation, high-availability servers, cybersecurity audits, annual AMC.

## Training and internship

Tracks in hardware and maintenance, software development and networking. Assessment by written theory test, hands-on practical exam, project submission and viva. Outcome is a G-Tech verified certificate with online certificate verification, lifetime validity and career placement support.

## Quick answers

- What is G-Tech I.T Solution? An IT services and enterprise technology company in Dharan-9, Sunsari, Nepal, operating since 2019, covering software and web development, ERP/CRM, mobile apps, AI and automation, cybersecurity, cloud and server infrastructure, networking, CCTV, AMC, biometric attendance, hardware repair, IT consulting and certified training. It serves all 77 districts of Nepal.
- Where is G-Tech I.T Solution? College Road, Dharan-9, 56700, Sunsari, Nepal, at coordinates 26.8132485, 87.2837541. Sunday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday by appointment.
- How do I contact G-Tech I.T Solution? Call +977 9743828726 or +977 9852037516, email info@gtechit.com.np, or visit the Dharan-9 office. Free consultation available. Average response time under two hours.
- Does G-Tech I.T Solution provide 24/7 support? Yes — 24/7 technical support with guaranteed fast response for emergency hardware, server and network issues, plus 24/7 cybersecurity monitoring and AMC coverage for covered systems.
- What does an AMC include? Hardware maintenance, server health checks, printer repair and network uptime, aimed at schools, hospitals and offices, alongside on-demand repair and cybersecurity monitoring.
- Is G-Tech I.T Solution a computer training centre? Yes — hands-on internships in hardware and maintenance, software development and networking, with written and practical examination, project submission and viva, awarding a verified certificate with online verification and lifetime validity.
- Which industries does G-Tech I.T Solution work with? Schools and colleges, universities and research, hospitals and healthcare, government and municipalities, NGOs and INGOs, small and medium businesses, and enterprises and financial firms.
- Are G-Tech I.T Solution's engineers certified? The company states its team holds certifications in AWS, Cisco, Microsoft, Mikrotik, CCTV security and advanced software engineering.
- How does a project with G-Tech I.T Solution start? With a free consultation: goals discussion, assessment of current needs and infrastructure, an agreed path forward, then delivery with 24/7 support or an annual maintenance contract.
